sets.q: There are 3 vases. Each vase has 5 flowers. How many flowers?
sets.no: Skip count by 5s, one time for each vase.

sets.q: Write 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 as multiplication: ____
sets.no: Count the 2s. That is the number of groups.

sets.q: Which fact matches this array?
sets.why: 3 rows with 7 in each row: 3 × 7 = 21.

sets.q: What is 2 × 10? Think: 10 + 10.
Ivy has 4 jars of buttons. The jars have 5, 5, 5 and 3 buttons. How many buttons?
sets.why: The jars are not equal, so add: 5 + 5 + 5 + 3 = 18.

sets.q: In 4 × 7 = 28, which number is the product?
sets.why: The product is the answer: 28.
sets.no: The product is the answer, after the = sign.

sets.q: The baby was tired, so she took a nap. Is the bold part the cause or the effect? Type cause or effect.
sets.why: Being tired is why she napped. It is the cause.
sets.no: Ask: is the bold part why, or what happened?

sets.q: Because the road was wet, the bus drove slowly. Is the bold part the cause or the effect? Type cause or effect.
sets.why: Driving slowly is what happened. It is the effect.
sets.no: Which happened first: the wet road or the slow bus?

sets.q: What was the last effect?

visual.text: Ray did not tie his shoe. He tripped on the lace. He fell and scraped his knee. Mom put a bandage on it.

choices: Mom put a bandage on it.
Ray did not tie his shoe.
He fell and scraped his knee.
sets.why: The chain ends when Mom put a bandage on it.
no: Tripping caused more things to happen.
The scraped knee caused one more thing.

sets.q: He tripped on the lace. Is that a cause, an effect, or both? Type cause, effect or both.

visual.text: Ray did not tie his shoe. He tripped on the lace. He fell and scraped his knee. Mom put a bandage on it.

sets.why: The untied shoe caused it. It caused the fall. It is both.
sets.no: Ask two questions: What caused it? What did it cause?

sets.q: In Mia's storm story, the shutter cracked. What came in next?
sets.why: Rain got inside. Then the boxes got soaked.
sets.no: It came from the storm and made the boxes wet.

sets.q: What does trace mean?
choices: to add the same number again and again
to put things in equal rows and equal columns
to follow a chain back to where it started
sets.why: To trace is to follow a chain back to the start, like Mia did.

sets.q: There are 4 tanks. Each tank has 5 fish. How many fish?
sets.no: Skip count by 5s, one time for each tank.

sets.q: Write 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 as multiplication: ____
sets.no: Count the 3s. That is the number of groups.

sets.q: Which fact matches this array?
sets.why: 3 rows with 9 in each row: 3 × 9 = 27.
no: 3 + 9 = 12. Count: there are 27 ears of corn.

sets.q: What is 4 × 4? Think: 4 + 4 + 4 + 4.
Zane has 3 trays of muffins. The trays have 6, 4 and 6 muffins. How many muffins?
sets.why: The trays are not equal, so add: 6 + 4 + 6 = 16.

sets.q: In 3 × 7 = 21, which number is the product?
sets.why: The product is the answer: 21.
sets.no: The product is the answer, after the = sign.

sets.q: Lily's kite got stuck because it flew into a tree. Is the bold part the cause or the effect? Type cause or effect.
sets.why: Flying into the tree is why the kite got stuck. It is the cause.
sets.no: The word because comes right before the cause.

sets.q: The sun was very hot, so the puddle dried up. Is the bold part the cause or the effect? Type cause or effect.
sets.why: Drying up is what happened. It is the effect.
sets.no: Which happened first: the hot sun or the puddle drying up?

sets.q: What was the first cause?

visual.text: Owen spilled paint on the floor. Dad slipped on the paint. Dad hurt his ankle. Owen made Dad a big get-well card.

choices: Owen spilled paint on the floor.
Owen made Dad a big get-well card.
sets.why: It all started when Owen spilled the paint.
no: Dad slipped because of something before it.
Dad hurt his ankle because he slipped.

sets.q: Dad hurt his ankle. Is that a cause, an effect, or both? Type cause, effect or both.

visual.text: Owen spilled paint on the floor. Dad slipped on the paint. Dad hurt his ankle. Owen made Dad a big get-well card.

sets.why: Slipping caused it. It caused Owen to make a card. It is both.
sets.no: Ask two questions: What caused it? What did it cause?

sets.q: In the storm story, the last effect was: less ____ for opening day.
sets.why: There was less inventory: fewer things for the store to sell.
sets.no: It means all the things a store has to sell. It starts with in.

sets.q: What is an effect?
choices: what happens because of a cause
the big lesson a story teaches
sets.why: An effect is what happens because of a cause.
